description: This source file implements the AgentDB class methods for managing radio interfaces, clients, and data model interactions within the prplMesh project. It includes functions for adding/removing radios, retrieving radio info by MAC, managing clients, and interfacing with a data model for configuration and state management.

classes.name: AgentDB
classes.description: Class responsible for managing radio interfaces, clients, and data model interactions within the agent component of prplMesh.

methods.name: radio
methods.description: Retrieve a radio entry by interface name.

methods.name: add_radio
methods.description: Add a new radio interface with front and back interface names.

methods.name: remove_radio_from_radios_list
methods.description: Remove a radio from the internal list by interface name.

methods.name: get_radio_by_mac
methods.description: Find a radio entry by MAC address, considering the MAC type hint.

methods.name: erase_client
methods.description: Remove a client MAC from radios and associated MLO clients, optionally using a BSSID.

methods.name: get_mac_by_ssid
methods.description: Retrieve the MAC address of a BSSID associated with a given SSID on a radio identified by ruid.

methods.name: get_ap_mld_mac_by_ssid
methods.description: Get the MLD MAC address for an AP with a specific SSID.

methods.name: init_data_model
methods.description: Initialize the data model object for configuration/state management.

methods.name: dm_set_agent_mac
methods.description: Set the agent's MAC address in the data model.

methods.name: dm_set_fronthaul_interfaces
methods.description: Set the fronthaul interfaces in the data model.

methods.name: dm_set_agent_state
methods.description: Update the current and maximum agent state in the data model.

methods.name: dm_set_management_mode
methods.description: Set the management mode in the data model.

methods.name: dm_create_fronthaul_object
methods.description: Create a fronthaul object in the data model for a specific interface.

methods.name: dm_set_fronthaul_state
methods.description: Update the state of a fronthaul object in the data model.

methods.name: dm_fronthaul_disconnected
methods.description: Remove a fronthaul instance from the data model upon disconnection.
